verdicts.node_rule: PASS: a layout is found, has observed order >= 4.8 and passes its pay-off threshold on 2 of 3 problems. KILL (frozen row): no layout found within the budget, or every found layout has an attempt ratio >= its depth gain on all three problems. FAIL: found, no layout passes, and not every found layout is at the kill level.
